nina_cs: Heads-up: Harborline Cargo (poc contact: rita@harborline) reached out asking to onboard a domain-tuned manifest parser + anonymizer. They require Private deployment, HSM for key ops, and redaction guarantees for customer IDs. Also asked about performance for real-time routing (aiming <=350ms p95). Needs eval plan + commercial convo on reserved capacity. Who can own?
jordan_se: I'll take technical lead. Quick Q: model framework/size and whether they want model hosted in their VPC or ours?
nina_cs: Rita: PyTorch 1.13, ~4.7B, will ship both model artifact and sample manifests. Prefer Redwood Private inside their VPC with HSM integration. NDA addendum requested to restrict debug logs.
tamir_safety: Safety checklist: define sensitive fields (customer_id, SSN-like customs refs, contact_phone), confirm no PHI, specify redaction policy (mask vs remove). We'll need targeted adversarial probes and a recall/precision target for redaction. Also need to confirm if telemetry can be collected for quality monitoring (they might refuse).
claire_pm: Flags: product needs to approve ephemeral KV cache only, no long-term token persistence. If they insist on p95 <=350ms for interactive traffic, ops may recommend small Dedicated pool nearest to APAC cluster. That impacts cost/renewal.
jordan_se: Operational ask: ask for ~600 anonymized rows + schema + traffic profile (QPS, concurrency). I'll prepare perf harness. Suggest trying quantization (int8) and dynamic batching disabled for latency test.
rita (harborline): we can provide anonymized dataset and schema. telemetry ok if hashed and retained under NDA. happy to do Private in our VPC. We prefer minimal cold-start latency.
tamir_safety: Proposed eval steps: 1) run redaction probe (500 adversarial examples) 2) extraction accuracy on canonical fields 3) web-scale prompt-injection checks 4) latency profile under 25/50/100 QPS. Deliverables: redaction FNR/FPR, false-negative high-severity list, per-endpoint p95/p99. Need data by Thu to keep timeline.
deploy_bot: infra-bot: created ticket CS-9012 "harborline manifest anonymizer onboarding" https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CS-9012 :white_check_mark:
jordan_se: example perf cmd for infra team:
```
./perf_runner --model harborline_artifact.pt --data manifests.jsonl --qps 25 --concurrency 8 --quantize int8 --out results.json
```
Use `--ephemeral-kv` to validate cache behavior.
claire_pm: commercial note: if they pick a Dedicated pool + HSM we'll surface reserved capacity tiers. @alex_sales please join QBR to discuss pricing and renewal cadence.
alex_sales: On it. I'll prepare a preliminary term sheet and margin calc for Dedicated + HSM. Also note renewal risk: if they commit to Dedicated early we need a clear usage ramp to justify.
nina_cs: Planning enablement call with Rita + infra lead next Tue 11am PT. I'll ask for dataset + schema before EOD Fri. I'll attach NDA addendum draft to CS-9012.
tamir_safety: also: add a checklist item to confirm KMS key rotation policy and whether HSM logs can be shipped to their SIEM.
jordan_se: once samples arrive I'll run perf + safety eval. ETA 72 hrs after samples. Will post results and recommended deployment (Private-in-VPC vs Dedicated-hosted fallback). :hourglass:
nina_cs: thanks team. tagging @alex_sales for renewal tracking and @claire_pm for product constraints. I'll update CS-9012 as items come in. :thumbsup:
